payout_quote: Open a checking account and we'll give you $300 cash
steps: Open a new Dupaco consumer share draft (checking) account using promo code CHECK300 online, or mention the offer in branch or by phone
Make qualifying deposits totaling at least $500 within 90 days of account opening (cash, checks, ACH, credit/debit card advances, wire transfers count; internal Dupaco transfers do not)
Meet Dupaco's Active Checking Definition within 90 days - set up direct deposit and use the account regularly, or complete qualifying debit, ACH, check or bill pay activity
$300 cash payout is deposited to the checking account 3-5 business days after all requirements are completed (account balance must be $0 or more at payout)
catches: New checking customers only - ineligible if you opened a Dupaco consumer checking account within 180 days after closing a prior one, or if any owner has an existing Dupaco checking account
Ineligible if you have a charged-off Dupaco deposit account or are 60+ days delinquent on any Dupaco loan at opening or payout
Cannot be combined with other checking offers; limited to one Dupaco consumer share draft checking account per member
Business share draft checking accounts are not eligible
1099 INT issued for the cash payout - member is responsible for applicable taxes
Must qualify for Dupaco Community Credit Union membership (serves the Iowa, Illinois, Wisconsin tri-state area)
biggest_catch: Requires both $500+ in real deposits AND active use of the account within 90 days - this is for people who will genuinely switch daily banking activity to Dupaco, and existing Dupaco checking owners are fully excluded.
eligibility: New Dupaco consumer checking customers in Dupaco's Iowa/Illinois/Wisconsin service area; no existing or recently-closed (within 180 days) Dupaco checking; no charged-off Dupaco accounts; not delinquent 60+ days on a Dupaco loan.
timing: $300 cash payout deposited 3-5 business days after all requirements are completed; deposit and activity requirements are due within 90 days of account opening.
